title: Floor Minus Three
covers: using integers for floors above and below zero, what 0 means, and naming the opposite of an integer on the number line
cert: using integers, explaining zero, and naming opposites on the number line

intro.caption: Lesson 7-1 — integers and their opposites. The Delvers just reached the dungeon's Lift Hall. The floors go up into the tower and down below zero. Three reader gates and a boss map stand between them and the treasure room.

balloons.t: The map says the treasure room is on floor 2. That's 2 floors UP from here.
Welcome to floor 0, delvers! Up is plus. Down is minus. Please read the buttons.
Minus three has a 3 in it. 3 is bigger than 2. So it's even HIGHER. Going up!

pages.caption: Kwame pressed −3. The minus sign means BELOW 0. Floor −3 is 3 floors down, not 3 floors up.

balloons.t: Above 0 is positive. Below 0 is negative. Kwame, you are BELOW.
This mirror sits right on 0. Whatever stands here shows up on the other side.
Same distance from 0, other side. That's an opposite!
Kwame says 0 means nothing. But floor 0 is the entrance. It's a real place.
Okay, okay. Zero is the starting line. Not a hole.
Need a map up, little delvers? Best map in the dungeon. Only slightly wrong.
Floor 2! Up two from zero. And only one slime bath.

win.caption: Integers are the counting numbers, their opposites, and 0. Negative integers sit below (or left of) 0, and positive integers sit above (or right of) it. Opposites are the same distance from 0 on different sides, and 0 marks a real starting point.

gates.title: Gate 1 · Place the Floors
gates.badge: Floor Finder — Integers Above and Below 0
gates.prompt: The lift's floors are a number line. Floor 0 is the entrance. Floors below it are negative.
hints: Conceptual: a minus sign means the other side of 0. Below the entrance means less than 0, so the floor number is negative.
Procedural: start at 0 and count one tick for each floor. Go left for floors below 0 and right for floors above 0.

steps: Practice: the bat cave is 2 floors below the entrance.
Below 0 means negative, so I write −2.
On the number line I start at 0 and count 2 ticks to the LEFT. That point is −2.
worked.q: The tower bell is 4 floors above the entrance. Which integer is its floor?

items.q: Kwame landed 3 floors below the entrance. Mark his floor.

fb.msg: That's floor 3, three floors UP. Kwame went down, so his floor is on the other side of 0.
That's the entrance, floor 0. Kwame dropped 3 floors from here.
That's 2 floors below. Count 3 ticks left of 0.

items.fbDefault: Start at 0 and count 3 ticks to the left.

items.q: The slime pit is 5 floors below the entrance. Which integer names its floor?

options.fb: 5 is 5 floors ABOVE the entrance. Below 0 needs a minus sign.
0 is the entrance itself. The pit is 5 floors away from it.
−4 is only 4 floors down. Count 5 floors below 0.

gates.pass: The lift panel glows: floor −3 marked, and the slime pit is −5. Kwame promises to read the minus sign next time.

gates.title: Gate 2 · The Mirror Room
gates.prompt: The mirror sits on 0. It shows each number's opposite: same distance from 0, other side.
hints: Conceptual: opposites are the same distance from 0. One is on the left of 0 and one is on the right.
Procedural: count how many ticks the number is from 0. Then count that many ticks on the other side.

steps: 7 is 7 ticks to the right of 0.
7 ticks to the left of 0 is −7. So the opposite of 7 is −7.

items.q: Sol stands on −4. Mark where her reflection appears: the opposite of −4.

fb.msg: That's Sol herself at −4. Her reflection is on the OTHER side of 0.
That's the mirror at 0. Sol is 4 ticks from it, so her reflection is 4 ticks away too.
Right side, but count again: −4 is 4 ticks from 0.

items.fbDefault: Count how far −4 is from 0. Go that far on the other side.

items.label: Opposite of the opposite of −6 =
items.aria: the opposite of the opposite of negative 6

fb.msg: That's only one flip: the opposite of −6 is 6. Flip again: the opposite of 6 is −6.
Opposites never land on 0 unless you start at 0. Flip −6 to 6, then flip back.

items.fbDefault: Flip −6 across 0. Then flip that answer across 0 again.

gates.pass: Sol waves at her reflection on 4. Two flips of −6 land back on −6: the mirror hands it right back.

gates.title: Gate 3 · What Does Zero Mean?
gates.prompt: In every story, 0 means something real. Bao checks what 0 means in each one.
hints: Conceptual: 0 is the starting point that you measure from. It is not a missing number.
Procedural: ask what is positive and what is negative in the story. 0 is the place between them.

steps: Practice: a thermometer in the ice cave.
Warmer than 0 °C is positive, colder than 0 °C is negative.
So 0 °C is the freezing point: the line between them. It is a real temperature.
worked.q: A diver is at 0 meters. Where is she?

items.q: On the dungeon lift, what does floor 0 mean?

options.t: The entrance level, with tower floors above and dungeon floors below

options.fb: Floor 0 is a real floor: the entrance. Zero is where the counting starts.

options.t: The very bottom of the dungeon
options.fb: Floors keep going below 0, to −1, −2, −3 and more. 0 is the middle, not the bottom.

options.t: The highest floor of the tower
options.fb: Positive floors like 1 and 2 are above 0. 0 is the entrance.

items.q: Bao writes a gain of 8 health points as +8 and a loss of 8 as −8. What does 0 mean on his chart?

options.t: The delver has no health left
options.fb: 0 here is a CHANGE of 0, not 0 health. It means the health did not go up or down.
Going down is a negative change, like −1. 0 is no change at all.

gates.pass: Bao's chart makes sense now: +8 is a heal, −8 is a hit, and 0 means nothing changed. Floor 0 is the front door.

gates.title: Boss Gate · Grimble's Map
gates.prompt: Grimble's map is "only slightly wrong." Check three floors before the party climbs.
hints: Conceptual: integers are whole numbers, their opposites, and 0. Opposites sit at the same distance on both sides of 0.
Procedural: for each claim, picture the floor on the number line. Is it above or below 0, and how many ticks?

steps: Practice: a sign says the armory is "the opposite of floor 1."
The opposite is 1 tick below 0, so the armory is on floor −1.

items.label: Lock 1 · The vault is on the opposite floor of 5. Floor:
items.aria: the floor that is the opposite of 5

fb.msg: That's floor 5 itself. The opposite is the same distance on the other side of 0.
0 is the entrance. The opposite of 5 is 5 floors on the other side of 0.

items.fbDefault: 5 is 5 floors above 0. Its opposite is 5 floors below 0.

items.q: Lock 2 · Grimble's map lists three floors. Which list has only integers?

options.fb: 2½ is between 2 and 3. Integers have no fraction part, so 2½ is not one.
−1.5 is between −2 and −1. It is not a whole number or the opposite of one.
3.5 is halfway between 3 and 4, so it is not an integer.

items.q: Lock 3 · Grimble says the treasure on floor 2 and the trap on floor −2 are on the same side of 0. Is he right?

options.fb: That's Kwame's button mistake. The minus sign puts −2 on the other side of 0.

options.t: No, they are opposites: same distance from 0, on different sides

options.fb: They are equally far: 2 floors each. Only the side is different.

gates.pass: Three locks open. The vault is on floor −5, the integers check out, and 2 and −2 are opposites. Grimble mutters something about refunds.

journal.heading: Lesson 7-1 — what the lift taught us
rows: The counting numbers, their opposites, and 0: …, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, …. Floors are integers. 2½ is not.
Below the entrance is negative: 3 floors down is −3. Above it is positive: 2 floors up is 2.
−4 and 4 are both 4 ticks from 0, on different sides. The opposite of the opposite of −6 is −6.
Floor 0 is the entrance. A health change of 0 means no change. 0 is where you measure from.
−3 is not "higher" because it has a 3. The minus sign puts it BELOW 0.
journal.quote: "Read the sign before you press the button. Trust me." — Kwame

teacher.suggested: Use during or after lesson 7-1 (Explore Integers and Their Opposites) as one focused read. Whole-class on a projector, pairs on devices, or independent practice. It covers only this lesson: using integers for quantities above and below 0, what 0 means in a situation, and opposites on the number line.
standards: Use positive and negative numbers to describe quantities with opposite directions or values, and explain the meaning of 0 in each situation
